importantNotes: Negative marking: 25% or 1/4th of the total marks will be deducted for each incorrect answer.
If more than one answer is given or if no circle is darkened in the OMR sheet, it will be treated as wrong and 25% or 1/4th of the total marks will be deducted.
If the sum of total final marks comes to a fraction, it will remain as a fraction and further processing will be done on that basis.
If a question is left unanswered, negative marking rule will not apply.
Final merit list will be based on the combined marks of objective test and interview.
